Nachash II. נָחָשׁ proper name, masculine 1. king of Ammon 1Sam 11:1 (twice in verse); 11:2 ; 12:12 ; 2Sam 10:2 ; 1Chr 19:1-2 , perhaps also 2Sam 17:27 ; ᵐ5 Ναας . 2 father of Abigail and Zeruiah 2Sam 17:25 , si vera lectio: ᵐ5 Ναας , but ᵐ5 L Ιεσσαι (compare 1Chr 2:16 ); We Geschichte. 2. 57 Anm. 1 Löhr defend נחשׁ ; dubious We Sm HPS. 3 giving name to a city , נ ׳עִיר 1Chr 4:12 , ᵐ5 πόλεως Ναας ; ᵐ5 L Ηρναας .
